name: Char.card_pow_char_pow
statement: MulChar R R'} (hχ : IsQuadratic χ) (ψ : AddChar R R') (p n : ℕ) [fp : Fact p.Prime] [hch : CharP R' p] (hp : IsUnit (p : R)) (hp' : p ≠ 2) (hg : gaussSum χ ψ ^ 2 = χ (-1) * Fintype.card R) : (χ (-1) * Fintype.card R) ^ (p ^ n / 2) = χ ((p : R) ^ n)

name: Char.card_pow_card
statement: Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] {F' : Type*} [Field F'] [Fintype F'] {χ : MulChar F F'} (hχ₁ : χ ≠ 1) (hχ₂ : IsQuadratic χ) (hch₁ : ringChar F' ≠ ringChar F) (hch₂ : ringChar F' ≠ 2) : (χ (-1) * Fintype.card F) ^ (Fintype.card F' / 2) = χ (Fintype.card F')

name: FiniteField.two_pow_card
statement: Type*} [Fintype F] [Field F] (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) : (2 : F) ^ (Fintype.card F / 2) = χ₈ (Fintype.card F)
